    suites=list(ET.parse(out/name).getroot().iter('testsuite'))
    counts={key:sum(int(s.get(key,0)) for s in suites) for key in ('tests','failures','errors','skipped')}
    counts['passed']=counts['tests']-counts['failures']-counts['errors']-counts['skipped']

name: publication_content_review
command:
import json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,UTC
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'results/stage2_b0_preparation'
base=['git','-c',f'safe.directory={root.as_posix()}']
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(base+list(args),text=True,encoding='utf-8')
files=git('diff','--cached','--name-only').splitlines()
records=[]; flags=[]
patterns=[re.compile(x) for x in (r'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}',r'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}',r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}',r'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----')]
for name in files:
    path=root/name; size=path.stat().st_size
    records.append(dict(path=name,bytes=size))
    if size>2_000_000 or path.suffix.lower() in ('.docx','.pdf','.pt','.pth','.ckpt','.zip') or '/development/' in name or '.venv' in name:
        flags.append(dict(path=name,reason='unexpected large/private/runtime file'))
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    if any(p.search(text) for p in patterns):flags.append(dict(path=name,reason='possible credential pattern; do not publish value'))
assert not flags, flags
new_code_files=git('diff','--name-only','a836922b2e1f81689d09e811c29be3badf2462aa','HEAD').splitlines()
record=dict(created_at_utc=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),status='STAGED_CONTENT_REVIEW_PASS',staged_files=records,staged_total_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in records),largest_files=sorted(records,key=lambda x:x['bytes'],reverse=True)[:5],secret_pattern_flags=flags,code_commit_files=new_code_files,excluded='project venv, protocol Word/private context, development/temp, engineering checkpoints',remote='https://github.com/Whsjbwy/FL-RL.git',branch=git('branch','--show-current').strip(),main_merge=False,force_push=False)
(out/'publication_content_review.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('status','staged_total_bytes','largest_files','branch')},indent=2))
